description: This PHP class defines a model for representing time formats within the OrangeHRM system's API. It encapsulates a time format identifier and provides a method to serialize this information into an array, which can be used for API responses or internal data handling.

classes.name: TimeFormatModel
classes.description: A model class representing the time format, implementing serialization to array for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TimeFormatModel with a given time format identifier.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the object's properties into an associative array for serialization purposes.
